answer.book: A single theological work, George Abbot's Explicatio sex illustrium quaestionum (Frankfurt 1616 reprint of the Oxford 1597 disputation), built as front matter (dedications, epistle, preface), six numbered chapters (Caput I–VI), each treating one question, and a closing alphabetical subject index.
